definitions.explanation: Liquid fat used for cooking, typically from plants.
General term for oily substances, including machine oil.

notes:
{油|あぶら} refers to oil, primarily cooking oil.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {油|あぶら}で{揚|あ}げる (deep-fry in oil)
- {油|あぶら}を{引|ひ}く (add oil to a pan)
- {油|あぶら}っこい (oily, greasy)
- {油|あぶら}を{売|う}る (idle away time - idiom)

KANJI NOTE:
- {油|あぶら}: oil (general, cooking)
- {脂|あぶら}: fat (from animals, body fat)

RELATED WORDS:
- サラダ{油|あぶら} (salad oil)
- ごま{油|あぶら} (sesame oil)
- オリーブオイル (olive oil)
